title.narrative: Child project of the Global Clean Hydrogen Programme of Egypt

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The Egypt Child Project of the GCHP aims to contribute to the overall goal and impact of the programme, working in alignment with the other National Child Projects under the guidance of the Global Child Project. The activities planned for the Egypt Child Project will support the country's energy transition by promoting the adoption of clean hydrogen technologies while delivering substantial socio-economic benefits across the target sectors.Socio-Economic Benefits of the Egypt Child Project:• Capacity Building and Job Creation:?Through capacity-building activities, awareness-raising initiatives, and national events, as well as participation in thematic working groups, e-training sessions, operationalization of the GHEC and the Global Knowledge Platform managed by the Global Child Project, stakeholders in Egypt will enhance their technical expertise needed for the clean hydrogen market's development. This capacity-building effort will lead to the creation of skilled jobs, particularly in sectors related to hydrogen production, infrastructure, and technology management. By disseminating knowledge and best practices, the project will empower local industries to develop a workforce capable of supporting long-term growth in the clean hydrogen economy.• Innovation and Industrial Development:?The project will foster technological innovation by encouraging collaboration among industry stakeholders, international experts, and local governments. Strategic support for green hydrogen implementation in industrial clusters or companies will be prioritised. Participation in the Global Knowledge Platform will enable Egypt to share local-level innovation case studies and best practices, contributing to south-south cooperation. This will accelerate the development of hydrogen-related technologies and industries, creating economic opportunities in sectors such as ammonia and fertilisers. These industries will generate both direct and indirect jobs, positioning Egypt as a global leader in the green hydrogen economy.• Energy Security and Economic Resilience:?By advancing clean hydrogen production, the Egypt Child Project will improve energy security by promoting hydrogen as a sustainable and locally sourced alternative to fossil fuels. This will reduce reliance on carbon-intensive energy sources and decrease carbon emissions. Additionally, the diversification of energy resources will enhance economic resilience, enabling Egypt to navigate global energy market fluctuations while supporting a stable and sustainable energy future.• Gender Inclusion and Social Equity:?The Egypt Child Project will prioritise gender inclusion by ensuring the participation of women and youth in project activities. With a target of 50% female and 20% youth participation, the project will create opportunities for underrepresented groups in the clean hydrogen sector. By developing gender-responsive knowledge products, the project will advance social equity, providing equal access to employment opportunities and ensuring the green hydrogen transition benefits are shared across all communities.• Health and Environmental Benefits:?By promoting clean hydrogen technologies, the project will help reduce air pollution in industrial and urban areas, enhancing public health outcomes. A shift away from fossil fuels will lower harmful emissions, improving air quality and reducing health issues linked to pollution. Environmentally, the project will significantly cut greenhouse gas emissions, contributing to national climate targets and fostering healthier living environments. • Knowledge Management and Sharing:?The Egypt Child Project will benefit from the Global Knowledge Platform, gaining access to cutting-edge research, best practices, and technological developments. Locally developed knowledge products will ensure continuous learning and innovation in hydrogen technologies. This knowledge-sharing ecosystem will extend the project's socio-economic impacts beyond its lifespan, building a legacy of sustainable development and fostering Egypt's role in the global clean hydrogen community.

To enhance national institutional capacities, improve enabling policy frameworks, and advance technological readiness and financial mechanisms for the successful uptake of clean hydrogen in Egypt, ensuring its net zero development with social considerations and benefits.
